paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.02% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+2.52%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.64%). Brent crude changed +0.04% to 102.35. Gold changed -1.07% to 4,157.2002. Bitcoin changed -2.47% to 82,413.3125. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of -0.30%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-9.92%) and Deutsche Bank (-6.52%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Germany blocks Chinese acquisition in its largest seaport (FT World). Berlin rejects state-owned Cosco’s takeover of a Hamburg port logistics group ‘on security concerns’ Deals and capital markets: EG Group delays IPO plans and draws takeover interest (FT Markets). Petrol station empire had filed for New York listing aiming to raise about $1bn at $9bn valuation Central banks and macro: French central bank chief says ECB intervention not needed to ease bond rout (FT World). Emmanuel Moulin also hit out at ‘Trump-style’ threats against him from the far-left Central banks and macro: French central bank head warns country at risk of being ‘strangled by interest rates’ (FT Markets). Emmanuel Moulin says France can still reassure bond investors despite ‘serious and worrying’ market moves in recent days Geopolitics and trade: Oil majors look beyond Middle East war in pursuit of region’s vast reserves (FT World). Western groups look to new investment opportunities despite the chaos and heightened risks caused by the conflict with Iran
